name: 泥潭1
group_note: NT/nitan lineage, no exact master-hash match to nitan170911/nitan6/hhsj; fixed a genuine content bug (accept_kill() in clone/user/user.lpc called is_killing(ob) instead of is_killing(ob->query("id")) -- is_killing() takes a string id everywhere else in the codebase); fixed efun::message() exc_target=0 rejection; boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc's is_banned() (this lineage bans anything that doesn't parse as a strict 4-part dotted-quad, which would otherwise ban ::1/non-dotted addresses too); fixed is_chinese()'s stale GBK byte-range check; fixed check_legal_name()'s stale byte-length min bound and a second, separate 4-byte(=2-char)-assumption bug in named.lpc's invalid_new_name() (rejected any single-character given name as "empty", and a sliding-window near-duplicate-name detector stepping by raw byte offsets instead of characters); the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc (create()/make_body()). The big one: adm/daemons/versiond.lpc (~2300 lines, a version-sync-and-checksum daemon with a TCP server/client bolted on) called socket_create/socket_bind/socket_listen/socket_accept/socket_address/socket_write/socket_close unconditionally across 13 separate functions, failing to compile the WHOLE FILE -- and logind.lpc's logon() calls VERSION_D->is_version_ok() unconditionally on every single connection, so the compile failure silently broke login for EVERY player, not just wizards. Per AGENTS.md §7.52's updated guidance, gutted only the socket-touching functions to no-ops (not the whole file, since is_release_server()/append_sn()/query() etc. are called from dozens of unrelated NPCs and commands elsewhere in the mudlib) -- this was the root cause of the connection hanging silently forever after the boot banner with no prompt and no error trace. Also found and fixed a genuinely broken/non-UTF8 directory and file names inherited from the original archive (20 entries under d/heimuya, d/jingzhou, d/tulong, d/beijing/map, and duplicated under a redundant work/version/ backup copy) that crashed the WASM test harness's Node-based directory scan outright (ENOENT on scandir) -- renamed to sanitized ASCII names, preserving content. Admin seeded via a code-level default in securityd.lpc's create() (wiz_status is declared nosave here -- never persisted to a save file at all, so there's no data file to edit; the seed must live in code) -- also had to mkdir -p a missing log/nosave/ directory that was silently aborting create() before reaching the seed line (restore()'s own log_file() call threw, uncaught within the object, only caught by master.lpc's outer preload() catch). New characters land in a /d/register/regroom.lpc requiring an in-game `register <email>` room-action before proceeding to the actual game world -- this and a per-second heartbeat-driven clock-redraw prompt made scripted post-registration command verification unreliable in the WASM test harness (same class of harmless timing artifact as nt6/nt6nitan6win); the core registration+world-entry+admin-recognition path is solidly verified regardless.
